assumptions: The submitted boundary is an explicitly provisional geometry. Its calculated area is a working value for intake and design comparison, not a precise official scoring area.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.

assumptions: ROAD-001 is a conceptual network alignment inside the provisional boundary, not an engineering centreline or statutory road.
Each connector expresses a required cross-corridor relationship at one key area; final routes depend on official road, rail, river, campus and ownership data.
The network is a conceptual accessibility framework and must be snapped to verified public rights-of-way after professional review.

osm_mapped_station_names_within_800m_cou.formula: count(distinct mapped railway/subway station names within an 800 m projected buffer of the provisional boundary)
assumptions: OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot accessed 2026-08-08; station names and positions may be incomplete, duplicated, changed or not represent accessible entrances.

osm_mapped_crossing_count.formula: count(OSM nodes tagged highway=crossing inside provisional boundary)
assumptions: This is a mapping completeness screen, not a safety or accessibility rating; every critical crossing requires field audit.

resident_transport_satisfaction_index.formula: weighted mean of resident ratings for walking continuity, crossing safety, cycling comfort, transit transfer, night-time comfort and service access
resident_transport_satisfaction_index.reason: No project-specific resident baseline survey has been completed.
